source.source_locator: 教則 第6章 6.4「目視外飛行」(1)1)フェールセーフ機能の例②

evidence.answer_defining_proposition: GNSS電波異常時には、位置維持・安全な自動着陸・代替位置情報取得などのフェールセーフが例示される。
evidence.tested_misconception: GNSS異常時には位置維持・安全着陸・代替測位は不要で、同じ経路を継続すればよい。
evidence.reasoning_path: GNSS anomaly -> navigation degradation -> hold/land/alternate-position-source response branch

collision.note: Tier B。Q138はBVLOS装備要件の束、Q139は操縦用電波断絶時の帰還/位置維持。本問はGNSS異常という別failure triggerと固有のresponse branchを問う。

independent_review.rationale: Tier B PASS. GNSS anomaly is a separate failure trigger from Q139 radio-link loss, with its own source-defined response branch of position hold, safe auto-landing or alternative positioning.

director_adjudication.rationale: The independent review is consistent with the merged B11 source-first plan, current Chapter 6 source and the 295-question canonical baseline. C004 is rejected because its answer-defining proposition converts source examples of probability and consequence mitigation into a stronger mandatory dual-consideration duty that is not explicit enough to accept under fail-closed source support. C010 is rejected because Q266 already tests stationary-front persistence and explicitly identifies Baiu/Autumn-rain fronts as examples; the proposed subtype framing adds insufficient solving-rule distinctness for the 400-target quality floor. The five accepted Tier B candidates C014, C017, C018, C019 and C020 retain material source-defined distinctions in temporal start-gate, GNSS failure, battery failure, explicit exception boundary and forced-landing lifecycle state. No accepted B11 candidate relies on a subsection explicitly marked 〔一等〕. The 20-candidate ceiling is not a quota. Two candidates are deliberately dropped without backfill. No HUMAN review is claimed or fabricated.
